Two adult '''creatures resembling bats''' and their small cub were seen cowering in a tree during an intense storm on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. One of the creatures protectively covered its cub with its wing to shield it from the storm. In addition to wings, the species also had tails and long ears.<ref name="1-10" />
